A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(lower(JSONExtractString(labels, 'repo'))) AS repo,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'state')) AS state,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'role')) AS role,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'pool')) AS pool
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  pts AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host, series.repo AS repo, series.state AS state,
           series.role AS role, series.pool AS pool,
           s.metric_name AS metric, s.unix_milli AS ms, s.value AS value
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name IN ('loom.forge.stage_items', 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots', 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
  ),
  repo_depth_at AS (
    SELECT repo, ms, sum(value) AS depth
    FROM pts
    WHERE metric = 'loom.forge.stage_items' AND state IN ('triage', 'unlabeled', 'curated_not_promoted', 'issue_no_pr') AND repo != ''
    GROUP BY repo, ms
  ),
  repo_depth AS (
    SELECT repo, min(depth) AS min_depth, argMax(depth, ms) AS last_depth
    FROM repo_depth_at
    GROUP BY repo
  ),
  host_repos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host, lower(attributes_string['loom.repo']) AS repo
    FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
    WHERE name IN ('loom.dispatch.step', 'loom.dispatch.disposition')
      AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(end_ms - 86400000)
      AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(end_ms)
      AND attributes_string['loom.repo'] != ''
  ),
  host_slots AS (
    SELECT host,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy_max,
           argMaxIf(value, ms, metric = 'loom.dispatch.busy_slots' AND role = 'sweep' AND pool = '') AS busy_last,
           maxIf(value, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS max_concurrent,
           minIf(ms, metric = 'loom.dispatch.max_concurrent') AS first_ms
    FROM pts
    WHERE host != '' AND metric != 'loom.forge.stage_items'
    GROUP BY host
  ),
  repo_slots AS (
    SELECT host_repos.repo AS repo,
           countIf(host_slots.max_concurrent > 0 AND host_slots.busy_last < host_slots.max_concurrent) AS hosts_with_free_slots,
           max(host_slots.busy_max / host_slots.max_concurrent) AS best_fill,
           min(host_slots.first_ms) AS first_ms
    FROM host_repos
    INNER JOIN host_slots ON host_slots.host = host_repos.host
    WHERE host_slots.max_concurrent > 0
    GROUP BY repo
  ),
  spawned AS (
    SELECT lower(attributes_string['loom.repo']) AS repo, count() AS n
    FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
    WHERE name = 'loom.dispatch.step'
      AND attributes_string['loom.dispatch.admission_result'] = 'spawned'
      AND timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}))
      AND timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}))
    GROUP BY repo
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       repo_depth.repo AS repo,
       toFloat64(repo_depth.last_depth) AS value
FROM repo_depth
INNER JOIN repo_slots ON repo_slots.repo = repo_depth.repo
LEFT JOIN spawned ON spawned.repo = repo_depth.repo
WHERE repo_depth.last_depth > 0
  AND repo_slots.hosts_with_free_slots > 0
  AND spawned.n = 0
ORDER BY repo

annotations.description: Repo {{$labels.repo}} shows {{$value}} items waiting for a step (loom.forge.stage_items in triage, unlabeled, curated_not_promoted or issue_no_pr, the captain's per-repo gauge) and at least one host that dispatches for it (by its loom.dispatch.step / loom.dispatch.disposition spans in the last 24 h) has a free slot, yet no loom.dispatch.step was spawned for the repo in 15 min. Since #11909 the work finder's step tick is the only item dispatch path, so this is dispatch stopped for the repo, not slow. On a host that dispatches for it: the work_finder log's 'step tick' lines, loom.dispatch.step refusals by loom.dispatch.reason, and pick.decision item_draw (pools, exclusions, refused_* counts). Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
